note: scientific semantics are deliberately recorded as an exemption instead
of a full scientific contract. An exemption is a reviewed claim that the
operator is a thin adapter over an upstream numeric core; the adapter's
own surface facts (parameters, determinism stamp, sidecar knowledge)
remain bound by their existing authorities and drift gates. Every entry
must carry a reason and an evidence anchor.
